name: SEO Toolkit
author: gayatripol

sections.description:
SEO Toolkit is a lightweight SEO automation plugin designed to simplify essential on-page SEO tasks for WordPress users.

It helps improve content structure and search visibility without the complexity of larger SEO suites.

This plugin helps you:
– Automatically generate meta descriptions
– Add lightweight internal linking automation
– Auto-fill missing image ALT text on frontend output
– Improve SEO with simple, automation-first tools
– Avoid heavy and bloated SEO dashboards

SEO Toolkit is ideal for bloggers, freelancers, agencies, and businesses looking for lightweight SEO improvements without the complexity of full SEO suites.

Features

  • Automatic Meta Descriptions
  • Internal Linking Automation
  • Auto Image ALT Text
  • Lightweight SEO Enhancements
  • Clean Dashboard UI
  • SEO Plugin Conflict Protection
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “SEO Toolkit” in the WordPress dashboard
  4. Configure your preferred SEO settings
sections.faq:
Does this replace Yoast or Rank Math?

No. SEO Toolkit is a lightweight SEO automation plugin for simple on-page improvements, not a full SEO suite.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is designed to stay lightweight and avoid unnecessary bloat.

Does it work with other SEO plugins?

Yes. SEO Toolkit avoids outputting meta descriptions when major SEO plugins like Yoast SEO or Rank Math are active.

Does it permanently save image ALT text?

No. The plugin improves missing image ALT text on frontend output for SEO and accessibility, without overwriting Media Library data.
